pokedexEntries.bk: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

pokedexEntries.wh: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

pokedexEntries.sw: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

pokedexEntries.sc: Their arms are made of a special liquid. They use psychic power to control these arms and crush boulders.
